name: NPM Install
description: Run a lockfile-bound npm ci with scripts disabled through a bundled wrapper.

guardrail_repo.description: Path to the Guardrail checkout that contains the npm install wrapper helper

package_dir.description: Relative path to the package directory containing package.json

lockfile.description: Relative path to package-lock.json or npm-shrinkwrap.json. File contents are content-hash bound at approval time.

steps.description: Run npm ci with scripts disabled against the approved package_dir and lockfile

constraints: Execution is fixed to npm ci with --ignore-scripts, --audit=false, and --fund=false
The approved lockfile content is content-hash bound at approval time
No extra registries, tags, or arbitrary npm flags are allowed through this recipe
invariants: Only package-lock.json or npm-shrinkwrap.json are accepted as the lockfile
The lockfile must live inside package_dir
The recipe never runs npm install or any postinstall/build scripts
